ELLEY-OH!

A space to make, play & learn together

Welcome, course creators!

Choose a block and draw on the course. Use the slider to explore the whole level. Place a start and a finish. Linked chapters end in an exit pipe: jump on top and press ↓ (S or the ▼ button) to go down to the next chapter. In the final chapter, walk through the house door to go inside, where the Crocodile Boss guards Queen Mom behind a gate and burps fire along the floor; jump over the flames. Stomp it or use powers three times to free her. ON/OFF switches flip every red and blue block: red blocks are solid while the switch says ON, blue blocks while it says OFF, and the other colour shows as a dotted outline you can pass through. Hit a switch from below, spin into it with the tail, or hit it with a kicked shell, fire or ice. Raccoons throw rocks at you in an arc; dodge them or stomp the raccoon. A bed box puts every critter on screen to sleep for 8 seconds: sleeping critters cannot hurt you. Stand on a dig spot (a little mound with a twinkle) and press ↓ to dig up a Daddo burger; sprint a little, jump, then keep tapping jump to fly. A sword block gives a sword: tap Sprint / power to swing it at critters, rocks, flames and blocks. Older short courses can use Make 12× longer to add new obstacles after your part.

Press Play. Move with ← → or A / D. Jump with Space, W or ↑. Hold Shift or the sprint button while moving to run faster and jump higher and farther. Small Elley-Oh! bumps bricks without breaking them. Hit a surprise block from below to knock its treat out! Jump on caramel chip critters, collect coins, and reach the exit pipe or final house!

Choose Treat, Milk, Shield, or Jump blocks in the toolbox to hide a surprise. They look like ordinary bricks in Play mode. Bump them from below, then touch the released item. Small Elley-Oh! leaves an empty block. Milk makes him grow; Big Elley-Oh! smashes bricks and releases anything inside. Enemy contact shrinks him, with a brief grace period to escape. If there is no room to grow, step into an open space. Shields protect against critters and spikes for 10 seconds; jump boosts last 12 seconds. Milk glasses walk along platforms, turn at walls, and fall off edges. If you die, choose Try again on the game-over sign. Open Sound setup to record or choose your own music and effects.

Choose who plays (Elley-Oh!, Henry the Carpenter, Princess Blyth, King Dadderoons or Queen Mom) and the level (Easy or Difficult) above the course, before a chapter or while paused. Queen Mom or King Dadderoons waits in the pink castle, picked at random for each chapter; when one of them plays, the other one waits. Princess Blyth can hover: keep holding jump in the air and she floats for up to 3 seconds with her skirt poofed out. In Difficult, a critter that touches a glass of milk drinks it and grows big, and big critters take two bonks; critters also walk faster and raccoons throw more often. Pick a Theme for sunny ground or underwater swimming. Use Shift, X, F, or tap Sprint / power to throw fire or ice, or spin a striped tail. Hold jump to float with the tail suit. Pick a Game style above the course, on the chapter introduction, or from the pause menu (Esc/P or the Pause button) to switch between 8-bit, 8-bit deluxe, 16-bit and modern looks. Each style changes Elley-Oh!, the blocks, the critters, the background and the built-in music. Each chapter keeps its own style.

Your chapters save automatically in this browser. World Maker links levels in order and lets you edit the story. Export whole story from the map to back up all chapters. Export downloads a file you can import on another computer.
